Ayuda.boton: Help for this screen: explains what it is for and how to use it.
FormInicio_351FI.ayuda: Home screen. It shows a summary of the library: active loans, overdue loans, unpaid fines and the total owed. To work, choose an option from the side menu.
FormPrestamo_351FI.ayuda:
Registers the loan of copies to a member.

1. Type the member's ID number (the list filters as you type), pick the member and press Select. The system checks that the member is allowed to borrow.
2. Search the available copies by code, title or author and add them to the detail with Add. Use Remove to take one out.
3. Press Confirm loan: a summary with the expected return date is shown and, once accepted, the loan is registered and the PDF receipt is issued.
FormPrestamo_351FI.btnAgregarSocio_351FI: Takes the member highlighted in the list and checks whether the member may borrow. If so, the member is assigned to the loan; if not, the reason is shown.
FormPrestamo_351FI.btnAgregarEjemplar_35: Adds the copy highlighted in the available list to the loan detail. A member that may borrow must be selected first.
FormPrestamo_351FI.btnQuitarEjemplar_351: Removes the highlighted copy from the detail; it shows up again among the available copies.
FormPrestamo_351FI.btnConfirmar_351FI.ay: Shows the summary with the expected return date and, if you confirm, registers the loan and generates the PDF receipt.
FormPrestamo_351FI.btnCancelar_351FI.ayu: Discards the loan in progress and closes the screen without registering anything.
FormDevolucion_351FI.ayuda:
Registers the return of an active loan.

1. Search the loan by its number or by the member's ID number (the grid filters as you type) and highlight it.
2. Check the summary: dates, days late and the fine if any.
3. Tick the box confirming that you received every copy and press Record return. If the member does not return all of them, the return is not registered.
Registers the return of the highlighted loan, makes the copies available again and, if it was late, calculates and records the fine. Issues the PDF receipt. Requires confirming complete reception.
FormDevolucion_351FI.btnCancelar_351FI.a: Closes the screen without registering the return.
FormMulta_351FI.ayuda:
Registers the payment of a member's unpaid fines.

1. Type the ID number of the member with fines (the list filters as you type), pick the member and press Select: the unpaid fines and the total owed are shown.
2. Choose the payment method (cash or card; with a card the number is requested).
3. Press Confirm payment to register it, or Member does not pay if the member does not pay: the fines stay unpaid.
FormMulta_351FI.btnSeleccionarSocio_351F: Takes the member highlighted in the list and shows the unpaid fines together with the total owed.
Registers the payment of all the member's unpaid fines using the chosen method (by card, only if the payment is approved) and issues the PDF receipt.
FormMulta_351FI.btnNoAbona_351FI.ayuda: Indicates that the member does not pay: no payment is registered, the fines stay unpaid and the member cannot borrow again until they are paid.
FormDonacion_351FI.ayuda:
Registers a member's donation of books to the library.

1. Type the donor member's ID number, pick the member and press Select.
2. Search the book by code, title or author and add it to the detail with Add (once for each donated copy). If the book is not in the catalog, register it first in Book management.
3. Press Confirm donation: the copies are created with their code and the donation is registered.
FormDonacion_351FI.btnAgregarSocio_351FI: Takes the member highlighted in the list as the donor.
FormDonacion_351FI.btnAgregarEjemplar_35: Adds one copy of the book highlighted in the list to the detail. The donor member must be selected first.
FormDonacion_351FI.btnQuitarEjemplar_351: Removes the highlighted row from the detail.
FormDonacion_351FI.btnConfirmar_351FI.ay: Shows the summary and, if you confirm, registers the donation and creates the copies with their code.
FormDonacion_351FI.btnCancelar_351FI.ayu: Discards the donation in progress and closes the screen without registering anything.
FormSocio_351FI.ayuda:
Manages the library members: creation, modification, deactivation and reactivation.

Search by ID number in the grid and highlight a member to load the data. Fill in first name, last name and ID number to create a new one. A deactivated member cannot borrow, pay fines or donate until reactivated. Some actions may be disabled depending on your role.
FormSocio_351FI.btnAlta_351FI.ayuda: Registers a new member with the typed data and assigns the member number.
FormSocio_351FI.btnModificar_351FI.ayuda: Saves the typed data (first name, last name, ID number) into the highlighted member after confirmation.
FormSocio_351FI.btnBaja_351FI.ayuda: Deactivates the highlighted member: the member can no longer borrow, pay fines or donate. Asks for confirmation.
FormSocio_351FI.btnReactivar_351FI.ayuda: Reactivates the highlighted deactivated member so that the member can operate again. Asks for confirmation.
FormSocio_351FI.btnLimpiar_351FI.ayuda: Clears the fields and the grid selection without changing any saved data.
FormSocio_351FI.btnCerrar_351FI.ayuda: Closes this screen and goes back to the home screen.
FormLibro_351FI.ayuda:
Manages the book catalog: creation, modification, deactivation and reactivation, with authors and subjects.

Type the title and tick the book's authors and subjects; if one is missing, add it with Add author or Add subject. The grid lets you search and highlight a book to edit it. Serialize exports the list to an XML file, Deserialize shows the content of an XML file and Refresh goes back to the database view.
FormLibro_351FI.btnAgregarAutor_351FI.ay: Creates a new author with the typed first and last name and leaves the author ticked for this book.
FormLibro_351FI.btnAgregarTema_351FI.ayu: Creates a new subject with the typed text and leaves it ticked for this book.
FormLibro_351FI.btnAlta_351FI.ayuda: Registers a new book with the typed title and the ticked authors and subjects, and assigns its code.
FormLibro_351FI.btnModificar_351FI.ayuda: Saves the current title, authors and subjects into the highlighted book after confirmation.
FormLibro_351FI.btnBaja_351FI.ayuda: Deactivates the highlighted book so it is not used in new operations. Asks for confirmation.
FormLibro_351FI.btnReactivar_351FI.ayuda: Reactivates the highlighted book. Its deactivated copies are reactivated separately, from Manage copies.
FormLibro_351FI.btnLimpiar_351FI.ayuda: Clears the fields and the grid selection without changing any saved data.
FormLibro_351FI.btnSerializar_351FI.ayud: Saves the books shown in the grid to an XML file, in the location you choose, and opens it when done.
FormLibro_351FI.btnDeserializar_351FI.ay: Reads an XML file of books and shows its content in the grid without saving it to the database.
FormLibro_351FI.btnActualizar_351FI.ayud: Shows the books stored in the database in the grid again.
FormLibro_351FI.btnCerrar_351FI.ayuda: Closes this screen and goes back to the home screen.
FormEjemplar_351FI.ayuda:
Manages the physical copies of books: creation, deactivation and reactivation.

Search the book by code, title or author and pick it from the list; Create adds a new copy with its code. To deactivate or reactivate a copy, highlight it in the grid. A deactivated copy is not available for loans.
FormEjemplar_351FI.btnAlta_351FI.ayuda: Creates a new copy of the chosen book and assigns its code.
FormEjemplar_351FI.btnBaja_351FI.ayuda: Deactivates the highlighted copy: it is no longer available for loans. Asks for confirmation.
FormEjemplar_351FI.btnReactivar_351FI.ay: Reactivates the highlighted copy so it is available for loans again. Asks for confirmation.
FormEjemplar_351FI.btnLimpiar_351FI.ayud: Clears the fields and the grid selection without changing any saved data.
FormEjemplar_351FI.btnCerrar_351FI.ayuda: Closes this screen and goes back to the home screen.
FormControlCambios_351FI.ayuda:
Lets you review the version history of the members' data and make a previous version current again.

Filter by member number, last name or date range with Filter, highlight a version in the grid and press Activate selected version so its data becomes the member's current data. The current data is shown on the right.
FormControlCambios_351FI.btnFiltrar_351F: Looks up the member versions that match the entered number, last name and dates.
FormControlCambios_351FI.btnActivar_351F: Makes the highlighted version current: the member's data is replaced with the data of that version. Asks for confirmation.
FormControlCambios_351FI.btnCerrar_351FI: Closes this screen and goes back to the home screen.
FormReporte_351FI.ayuda:
Generates and exports the library reports.

Choose the date range, press the report you want to see (Loans and returns, or Fines and donations) to get the preview and then Export to PDF to save it to a file.
FormReporte_351FI.btnReportePrestamos_35: Builds the preview of the loans and returns report for the chosen date range.
FormReporte_351FI.btnReporteMultas_351FI: Builds the preview of the fines and donations report for the chosen date range.
FormReporte_351FI.btnExportar_351FI.ayud: Saves the report shown in the preview to a PDF file, in the location you choose, and opens it when done. It is enabled after generating a preview.
FormReporte_351FI.btnCerrar_351FI.ayuda: Closes this screen and goes back to the home screen.
FrmBackup_351FI.ayuda:
Lets you create a backup of the database or restore a previous one.

Backup saves a .bak file in the location you choose. Restore replaces the current data with that of the chosen file and, when finished, closes the session.
FrmBackup_351FI.btnBackup_351FI.ayuda: Saves a backup of the database to a .bak file, in the location you choose.
FrmBackup_351FI.btnRestore_351FI.ayuda: Replaces the current data with that of a chosen .bak file, after confirmation. The session is closed when finished.
FrmBackup_351FI.btnSalir_351FI.ayuda: Closes this screen and goes back to the home screen.
FrmBitacora_351FI.ayuda:
Lets you consult the system event log.

The most recent days are shown by default. Combine the filters (user, module, event, criticality and dates) and press Apply to see the matching records. Export to PDF saves what the grid shows to a file.
FrmBitacora_351FI.btnAplicar_351FI.ayuda: Shows in the grid the log records that match the chosen filters.
FrmBitacora_351FI.btnLimpiar_351FI.ayuda: Clears the filters and shows the records of the most recent days again.
FrmBitacora_351FI.btnImprimirBitacora_35: Saves the records shown in the grid to a PDF file, in the location you choose, and opens it when done.
FrmBitacora_351FI.btnSalir_351FI.ayuda: Closes this screen and goes back to the home screen.
FrmGestionRoles_351FI.ayuda:
Lets you create and delete roles and permission families.

Choose whether you are creating a Role or a Family, type the name, tick the components that make it up and press Create. Picking a role or family in the lists shows its composition in the preview; Delete removes the selected one.
FrmGestionRoles_351FI.radRol_351FI.ayuda: Indicates that what will be created is a role.
FrmGestionRoles_351FI.radFamilia_351FI.a: Indicates that what will be created is a permission family.
FrmGestionRoles_351FI.btnCrear_351FI.ayu: Creates the role or family with the typed name and the ticked components.
FrmGestionRoles_351FI.btnEliminarSelecci: Unticks every component in the list. It does not delete any role or family.
FrmGestionRoles_351FI.btnBorrarRol_351FI: Deletes the role chosen in the list, after confirmation.
FrmGestionRoles_351FI.btnBorrarFamilia_3: Deletes the family chosen in the list, after confirmation.
FrmGestionRoles_351FI.btnSalir_351FI.ayu: Closes this screen and goes back to the home screen.
FrmGestionUsuarios_351FI.ayuda:
Manages the system users.

Fill in ID number, first name, last name, e-mail, username and role to create one with Create. Highlight a user in the grid to edit, unlock or activate/deactivate it. The typed data can also filter the grid with Apply, and you can show only active users or all of them.
FrmGestionUsuarios_351FI.radioButton1_35: Shows only the active users in the grid.
FrmGestionUsuarios_351FI.radioButton2_35: Shows all users in the grid, active and inactive.
FrmGestionUsuarios_351FI.btnCrearUsuario: Creates a new user with the entered data and role.
FrmGestionUsuarios_351FI.btnModificarUsu: Lets you change the data of the user highlighted in the grid.
FrmGestionUsuarios_351FI.btnDesbloquearU: Unlocks the highlighted user so the user can sign in again.
FrmGestionUsuarios_351FI.btnCambiarEstad: Activates the highlighted user if inactive, or deactivates it if active. Asks for confirmation.
FrmGestionUsuarios_351FI.btnAplicarCambi: Filters the grid with the typed data (ID number, first name, last name, e-mail, username and role).
Closes this screen and goes back to the home screen.
frmCambiarClave_351FI.ayuda:
Lets you change your user's password.

Enter your current password and the new one, and press Confirm. Once changed, the session is closed and you must sign in again with the new password.
frmCambiarClave_351FI.btnConfirmar_351FI: Changes your password to the new one and closes the session so you sign in again.
FrmLogin_351FI.ayuda: System sign-in screen. Type your username and password and press Sign in. The list in the top corner lets you choose the application language.
FrmLogin_351FI.btnEntrar_351FI.ayuda: Signs in with the entered username and password and opens the main menu.
FrmRepararInconsistencia_351FI.ayuda: System maintenance screen. The records that need attention are listed and, when you highlight one, its detail is shown. Choose one of the two available actions: restore a backup or recalculate the check digits.
FrmRepararInconsistencia_351FI.btnRealiz: Restores a chosen backup (.bak) file, after confirmation.
FrmRepararInconsistencia_351FI.btnRestau: Recalculates the check digits of the system records.
FrmMenu_351FI.ayuda: Main menu. The options in the side panel open each screen in the central area; only those allowed for your role are shown. The list in the top bar changes the language. The Help button in the panel shows the explanation of the open screen.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnInicio_351FI.ayuda: Opens the home screen, with the summary of loans and fines.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnRegistrarPrestamo_351FI: Opens the screen to register the loan of copies to a member.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnRegistrarDevolucion_351: Opens the screen to register the return of an active loan.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnCobrarMultas_351FI.ayud: Opens the screen to collect a member's unpaid fines.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnRegistrarDonacion_351FI: Opens the screen to register a book donation.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnGestionSocios_351FI.ayu: Opens member management: creation, modification, deactivation and reactivation.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnGestionLibros_351FI.ayu: Opens the management of the book catalog, with authors and subjects.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnGestionEjemplares_351FI: Opens copy management: creation, deactivation and reactivation.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnControlCambios_351FI.ay: Opens the member change control, to review versions and activate a previous one.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnReportes_351FI.ayuda: Opens the library reports, which can be exported to PDF.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnUsuarios_351FI.ayuda: Opens the management of system users.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnGestionRoles_351FI.ayud: Opens the management of roles and permission families.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnBitacora_351FI.ayuda: Opens the log to consult the system events.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnGestionRespaldo_351FI.a: Opens backup management: create and restore.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnCambiarClave_351FI.ayud: Opens the screen to change your user's password.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnAyuda_351FI.ayuda: Shows the help of the screen you have open: what it is for and how to use it.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnRelogin_351FI.ayuda: Opens the sign-in screen to sign in again, for example with another user.
FrmMenu_351FI.btnLogout_351FI.ayuda: Closes your session and leaves the system, after confirmation.
